title: MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science
abstract: arXiv:2611.28324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Materials science research is a non-linear, long-horizon process. Existing scientific agents, however, largely rely on specific task execution or predefined workflows, rendering them brittle in open-ended settings. To bridge this gap, we present MatHarness, an agent harness designed for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research spanning the complete lifecycle from initial ideation to manuscript writing. MatHarness couples three mechanisms: execution robustness through pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing; epistemic adaptability through persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model; and collective intelligence through a heterogeneous multi-agent round table under targeted human oversight. translated_title: MatHarness：面向计算材料科学的长周期开放式自动研究
translated_abstract: 材料科学研究是一个非线性、长周期的过程。然而，现有的科学智能体主要依赖于特定任务执行或预定义的工作流程，这使它们在开放式场景中显得脆弱。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了MatHarness，这是一个专为开放式、长周期计算材料研究设计的智能体框架，涵盖从初始构思到论文撰写的完整研究生命周期。MatHarness结合了三种机制：通过预检验证、专家蒸馏技能和即时审计实现执行鲁棒性；通过持久化研究产物和不断演化的科学心智模型实现认知适应性；以及在针对性人类监督下通过异构多智能体圆桌会议实现集体智能。我们在Cu-Zn合金中吸附诱导的表面偏析问题上评估了MatHarness，这是甲醇合成催化领域的一个开放性问题。在历时数周、消耗约……的研究轨迹中（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了MatHarness，一个面向计算材料科学的开放式长周期自动研究智能体框架，通过执行鲁棒性、认知适应性和多智能体集体智能三大机制，实现了从研究构思到论文撰写的完整生命周期自动化研究。
en_tdlr: MatHarness is an agent harness for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research that couples execution robustness, epistemic adaptability, and multi-agent collective intelligence to automate the complete research lifecycle from ideation to manuscript writing.
